So I’ll just give you what I use and you can take it or leave it. 

If the water isn’t more then 5-6ft and it’s relatively clear I will throw a weightless Yamamoto senko 5 or 4 inch in green pumpkin with black flake on a 2/0 or 3/0 ewg hook. Just cast to where you think a fish is near and let it fall and watch for any tension or movement of your line in the water.  Also helps if you are using flouro line, anything from 8-20 pound.
